scripts.check: node --check bin/strap && node --check bin/strap-agent.js && node --check bin/strap-llm.js && node --check bin/strap-loop.js && node --check bin/strap-mcp.js && node --check bin/strap-porcelain.js && node --check bin/strap-run-calls.js && node --check bin/strap-state.js && node --check bin/strap-zk-embed.js && node --check src/*.js && node --check mcp-servers/*.js && (command -v nu >/dev/null && nu --commands 'source bin/strap-zk.nu; source tools/zk; source porcelain/loop.nu' || true)
scripts.smoke: node bin/strap-state.js init > /tmp/strap-smoke.json && node bin/strap-state.js add-user 'hello' < /tmp/strap-smoke.json > /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json && node bin/strap-llm.js compile-openai --model test-model < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-openai.json && node bin/strap-llm.js compile --provider providers.example/openai-api-key.json < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-provider-openai.json && node bin/strap-llm.js compile --provider providers.example/openrouter.json < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-provider-openrouter.json && node bin/strap-llm.js compile --provider providers.example/anthropic.json < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-provider-anthropic.json && node bin/strap-agent.js fork --prompt 'inspect docs' < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-child.json && node bin/strap-agent.js fold --child /tmp/strap-child.json --summary 'child result' < /tmp/strap-smoke-2.json > /tmp/strap-folded.json && node -e 'import("./src/registry.js").then(async ({toolMap})=>{ const tool=toolMap("scripts").get("json_echo"); if(!tool) throw new Error("missing json_echo"); const result=await tool.execute({value:"ok"}); if(!result.content[0].text.includes("ok")) throw new Error(result.content[0].text); })' && node bin/strap-porcelain.js list > /tmp/strap-porcelain-list.json && (command -v nu >/dev/null && node bin/strap-state.js init | node bin/strap-porcelain.js run basic ask 'hello from porcelain' > /tmp/strap-porcelain-state.json || true) && (command -v nu >/dev/null && command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null && rm -f /tmp/strap-zk-smoke.sqlite /tmp/strap-zk-smoke.sqlite-shm /tmp/strap-zk-smoke.sqlite-wal && STRAP_ZK_EMBED_PROVIDER=hash nu bin/strap-zk.nu create --db /tmp/strap-zk-smoke.sqlite --title 'Local hash memory' --body 'Offline smoke indexing works without network.' --tags smoke > /tmp/strap-zk-create.json && STRAP_ZK_EMBED_PROVIDER=hash nu bin/strap-zk.nu search-hybrid --db /tmp/strap-zk-smoke.sqlite 'offline indexing' > /tmp/strap-zk-search.json && STRAP_ZK_EMBED_PROVIDER=hash node -e 'import("./src/registry.js").then(async ({toolMap})=>{ const tool=toolMap("scripts").get("zk"); if(!tool) throw new Error("missing zk"); const result=await tool.execute({action:"search_hybrid",db:"/tmp/strap-zk-smoke.sqlite",query:"offline indexing",limit:2}); if(!result.content[0].text.includes("Local hash memory")) throw new Error(result.content[0].text); })' || true)
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run smoke
